# Federation of State Medical Boards (FSMB)

> > The FSMB provides physician credential verification and digital certification services through secure, trusted verification portals.

The Federation of State Medical Boards operates a comprehensive credential verification system for physicians, leveraging digital certification and signature validation technologies. FSMB serves as a central hub for medical board coordination and physician credential management across state medical boards.

- FSMB

## Credential Verification Portal

- [FSMB Verification Portal](https://certs.fsmb.org/): FSMB physician credential verification and digital certification portal for secure credential validation
